messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Region fallback oscillation detected (automated). Multiple regions failing health checks then recovering in quick succession. Affected route: /v1/generate (smart-routing). Triggered at 2024-11-06T14:17:36Z (thread_ts=1715123456).

incident-bot: Summary metrics: us-east fail->ok x3 in 2m, us-west fail->ok x4 in 3m, eu fail->ok x2 in 90s. Error spike: 5xx rate to fallback model increased from 0.2% -> 2.8%. Latency P95 rose from 120ms -> 680ms in affected requests.

maria_sre: acked — taking ownership, pinging platform to stop dangerous rollouts.

lee_platform: on it. I see the routing policy has `fallback: cross-region` with `stabilize_window_ms: 1000` and `health_fail_threshold: 1`. likely too aggressive for this noisy probe.

andrew_oncall: confirming — traffic pattern looks like small probes hitting pod readiness toggles. recent k8s node reboots in us-west at 14:12. Could be liveness/ready interplay with deployment rolling update.

maria_sre: steps: 1) pause cross-region failover in routing policy, 2) increase health_fail_threshold to 3, 3) set short circuit-breaker to avoid immediate re-failovers. Applying now as emergency mitigation.

lee_platform: runbook cmds: 
```
# view current policy
redwoodctl routing get-policy --route /v1/generate --format yaml
# patch to prefer local region and raise thresholds
redwoodctl routing patch --route /v1/generate --set fallback=prefer-local --set health_fail_threshold=3 --set stabilization_ms=120000
```

maria_sre: applied patch: `fallback=prefer-local`, `health_fail_threshold=3`, `stabilization_ms=120000` — rollout is at 100% for the control plane. Pushing config now.

ops-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: routing policy for /v1/generate updated by maria_sre at 2024-11-06T14:19:12Z.

andrew_oncall: monitoring metrics. us-west flip rate dropping. us-east still a couple fails but not re-routing. latency trending down.

sarah_support: heads-up: support page shows 4 tickets referencing elevated latency and occasional 502s from eu customers. I'm messaging the top-3 affected orgs with ETA.

lee_platform: curious note — on startup we saw a mismatched model-variant label on one fallback pool in eu (`variant: v2-beta` instead of `v1-stable`). If cross-region fallback had triggered, some requests would've hit beta variant and returned different shape causing a small error spike. I've pinned fallback pools to `v1-stable` in eu as well.

maria_sre: that mismatch explains the error pattern. good catch. For safety, I've added a temporary pin in routing: `allowed_fallback_variants=[v1-stable]`.

andrew_oncall: system-level healthchecks now show steady OKs for 7 consecutive intervals. No new cross-region hops in the routing trace logs.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated rollback prevented — policy mutated instead of full rollback. No further re-failovers in last 6 minutes.

maria_sre: mitigation checklist complete: 
- Pause cross-region fallback (done)
- Raise thresholds (done)
- Pin allowed fallback variant (done)
- Notify support & customers (sarah done)
- Collect logs/traces for postmortem (collecting)

lee_platform: leaving a sticky config snippet for postmortem: 
```
routing:
  /v1/generate:
    fallback: prefer-local
    stabilization_ms: 120000
    health_fail_threshold: 3
    allowed_fallback_variants: [v1-stable]
```

andrew_oncall: paging: cleared. I'm handing off to lee_platform for post-incident watch. Maria, can you own the postmortem?

maria_sre: yes, I'll draft. initial impact estimate: ~5% of global requests in the 14:12–14:20 window experienced cross-region fallbacks; ~0.8% resulted in client-facing 5xx or malformed responses due to variant mismatch. Affected customers: acct-112, acct-431, acct-990 (support notified).

sarah_support: noted — I'll follow up with the three customers with an interim incident summary and ETA for root-cause.

lee_platform: continuing 30m watch. Will verify no config drift and run a targeted canary to confirm stable behavior: `redwoodctl routing simulate --route /v1/generate --region eu --load 50rps --duration 60s`.

ops-bot: HEARTBEAT: all regions healthy at 2024-11-06T14:27:10Z.

maria_sre: follow-ups/outcomes to include in postmortem: 
- adjust default routing stabilization thresholds (proposal: health_fail_threshold=3 for all smart routes)
- add variant-compat checks in CI for fallback pools to prevent mixing beta variants
- improve healthcheck debounce on node reboot to avoid transient readiness flips
- add an automated policy guard to prevent aggressive cross-region fallback when recent node reboots detected

andrew_oncall: adding a short-term alert rule: if cross-region fallback >1% requests in 5m, escalate to pagers.

maria_sre: closing thread for now — mitigation stable, monitoring OK. I'll post the initial incident doc in #postmortems in next hour. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

lee_platform: thx. leaving notes in infra board.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED: Region routing oscillation mitigated at 2024-11-06T14:31:30Z (resolved_by=maria_sre).

maria_sre: (postscript) saved traces: `s3://redwood-incidents/1715123456/` — will attach in postmortem.
